descriptions.zh:
这艘迅游舰将通过平衡乘客的愿望和船员的需求，永远遨游星际。完成乘客或船员合约都会影响当前局势。

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]
descriptions.en:
This cruise will travel the stars forever by juggling passenger wishes and crew needs. Completing both Passenger or Crew Contracts affect the situation.

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]

永恒巡游已经结束，发动兵变的船员已经夺取了舰桥。

sections.en:
§HOngoing Mutiny§!
§RNo contracts can be accepted.§!

The Forever Cruise is gone and mutineers have seized the bridge.

§YReform the government to conclude the situation.§!

descriptions.zh:
方舟飞船§Y[Target.GetName]§!的人工智能核心因内部指令冲突而发生故障，导致其分裂。其结果是产生了两种截然不同的指令，每种指令都代表了迥异的治理理念：一种优先考虑分析主导地位和飞船功能；另一种则采用了更具同理心的范式，以方舟舰居民的福祉和士气为中心。
最终，只能保留一种指令。
descriptions.en:
A malfunction born of internal directive conflict has split the AI core aboard Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! The result is the emergence of two distinct directives, each embodying a divergent philosophy of governance. One prioritizes analytical dominance and ship functionality. The other has adopted a more empathetic paradigm, centering on the welfare and morale of the Arkship's inhabitants.
In the end, only one directive can remain.

descriptions.en: Our ['concept_operational_reserves'] are our combined energy and mineral reserves.[Owner.GetSystemsVisited]

descriptions.zh:
方舟舰§Y[Target.GetName]§!的结构框架被评估为急需全面翻新。工程将分区域进行，各区域将依次离线并暂时安置居民。

这个项目的运营方式将决定最终成果的质量。
descriptions.en:
The structural framework of Arkship §Y[Target.GetName]§! has been assessed as overdue for comprehensive renovation. Work will continue by section, taking districts offline in sequence and temporarily displacing inhabitants.

How the project is managed will determine the quality of the outcome.

sections.zh: 一项决议悬而未决。翻新工程暂停，直至问题解决。
sections.en: A decision is pending. Refurbishment progress is paused until it is resolved.

descriptions.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
descriptions.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

sections.zh: §Y方舟舰§!必须在§H180§!天内返回§Y[Target.GetName]§!的轨道，否则侵蚀行动将被放弃。
sections.en: An §YArkship§! must return to orbit of §Y[Target.GetName]§! within §H180§! days or the consumption will be abandoned.

descriptions.zh: 方舟舰释放出纳米机群，溶解并占据这个世界。岩石、土壤和大气被分解，并重组为纳米机器。
descriptions.en: The Arkship releases its nanite swarms to dissolve and claim this world. Rock, soil, and atmosphere are broken down and reassembled into nanites.
